description: Line counts of verify-integrate doc surfaces. Re-anchored after the REVIEW scope-narrowing wave legitimately extended the doc surface with load-bearing content: docs/spec.md gained the 'Scope boundary — REVIEW reviews the PR's OWN diff, never merge state' paragraph in the REVIEW-is-advisory section + the matching REVIEW invariant (the reviewer emits findings ONLY about this PR's own base..head diff and NEVER about merge conflicts, mergeability state, or cross-PR version-bump/shared-file collisions — owned by RECONCILE + the VERIFY/INTEGRATE merge gates), growing spec.md from 553 to 569; docs/contract.md is unchanged at 56 (its reviewer-agent entry was tightened in place with the same exclusion). The housekeep e2e test asserts the current docs are NOT LARGER than these baselines (a reduced|no-op verdict) and that the load-bearing tokens survived.
